champion.tips: MORDEKAISER TIPS AND TRICKS Focus the biggest threat on the enemy team with your Ultimate R in team fights. This will make it easier for your team to handle the rest of them. As many Mid laners will be ranged, try and stay as far back as possible so the enemy is unable to harass you down with their basic attacks. When the enemy Jungler ganks your lane, take the weakest champion into the Shadow Realm R and try to turn the exchange around. Only do this however if you can kill the enemy. No need to try it if you can escape.
champion.builds: THE BEST MORDEKAISER BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Mordekaiser Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your first item, followed by Mercury's Treads and Riftmaker. For your last 3 items, you should build Liandry's Torment, Spirit Visage and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 56.1% winrate over 431 matches played. Optional Your second option for Mordekaiser Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Riftmaker, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Experimental Hexplate as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Thornmail and Zhonya's Hourglass. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 56.1% win rate over 214 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Conditioning with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Rylai's Crystal Scepter as a third item. You want to finish the build with Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment and Thornmail. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 60.9% win rate across 92 matches played. Situational Mordekaiser Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Mordekaiser build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Mordekaiser runes page.
